mapper.insert: INSERT INTO project ( category_id, creator_id, title, content_blocks, goal_amount, current_amount, end_at, status ) VALUES ( #{command.categoryId}, #{creatorId}, #{command.title}, #{command.contentBlocks}, #{command.goalAmount}, #{command.currentAmount}, #{command.endAt}, #{command.status} )
mapper.select: SELECT id as projectId, title, goal_amount as goalAmount, current_amount as currentAmount, end_at as endAt, status FROM project WHERE creator_id = #{creatorId}

SELECT pa.id as addressId, pa.user_id as userId, pa.recipient_name as recipientName, pa.phone, pa.postal_code as postalCode, pa.address_main as addressMain, pa.address_detail as addressDetail FROM pledge_address pa JOIN pledge p ON pa.pledge_id = p.id WHERE p.project_id = #{projectId}
